groups.name: spring.setting.memory
groups.description: Configuration properties for Spring Setting Memory module using Caffeine cache.

properties.name: spring.setting.memory.maximum-size
properties.description: Maximum number of entries that can be cached. Defaults to 10,000.

properties.name: spring.setting.memory.expire-after-write
properties.description: Duration after which entries expire after being written to the cache. Defaults to 1 minute.

values.description: Default cache size for most applications
30 seconds - very short cache for frequently changing data
1 minute - default for most use cases
5 minutes - longer cache for stable data
1 hour - long cache for rarely changing data
